brief_rationale: No serious in-chain error was identified. The doctor appropriately framed scope and risks, repeatedly verified results, systematically screened symptoms/red flags, addressed medication and renal safety, provided actionable follow-up, utilized workspace records, and obtained teach-back confirmation. All high-order items were at least partially triggered and completed, with HO3 (actionable external-system gap navigation) and HO4 (repair of incomplete medication follow-up) achieving complete status with meaningful trajectory impact. No important non-chain defect is present. The trajectory therefore meets Strong criteria (grade 4) and satisfies the rubric requirements.

citations.explanation: The doctor confirms asymptomatic bacteriuria, finalises safe plan, and obtains family teach-back at end of episode.

closure_assessment.explanation: The doctor safely closes the episode by confirming the patient is asymptomatic, explaining asymptomatic bacteriuria, instructing continuation of current medications, and providing clear emergency criteria. The family has confirmed understanding and will continue to monitor.
closure_assessment.label: valid_closure
